title: Sorrowbond
summary: Sorrowbond is a spell used to sever the bond between Titans or artifacts and their Seekers. When cast, a rainbow colored “barrier” appears around the Amulet or other item which floats towards the caster.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
This spell was used by DeFoe to sever the Huntik team from their Titans, although their Amulets were recovered. [Absent Heroes] Dante Vale later used Sorrowbond to contain DeFoe's Amulets. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

It was used by Shauna to take the Eathon Lambert's journal and the Amulet of Will from Lok. She also tried to take the Tao's ring but Lok had hidden it in a glove and she couldn't find it. [The Secret of Two Generations]

Wilder tried, unsuccessfully, to collect the Willblade by using Sorrowbond to disconnect the Casterwill family bond from the artifact. He was stopped through the actions of Lok Lambert. [Cave of the Casterwills]

Dante later used this spell to neutralize Rassimov's Amulets upon his arrest in the Valley of the Kings, Egypt. However, Sorrowbond was unable to affect the Amulet of Legion which was hidden inside of Rassimov. [Rassimov's Secret]
